prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>, with his lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features; at home he wears only his plain gray crew-neck T-shirt, without the overshirt.

summary:
[reference generation] At home in the evening, <Subject 1> types a short reply on his phone, smiles noticeably, taps send and leans back in his desk chair, a beer can on the desk beside him.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build and plain gray crew-neck T-shirt are retained; the dark blue-gray overshirt is removed for the home scene.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field and natural skin texture, in soft warm practical lighting.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, seated in a dark desk chair at home in the evening and turned three-quarters toward the left, wearing only his plain gray crew-neck T-shirt with short sleeves. A warm desk lamp with a beige shade at the left casts soft golden light across his face; wooden bookshelves with plain book spines and a small plant stand softly out of focus behind him, and the window is dark blue. On the light wooden desk in the lower right are an open book and one silver-blue beer can with a blue top, standing upright. He holds a black smartphone in both hands at chest height, its screen facing him and away from the camera. His eyes are on the screen; both thumbs type a short message in small, quick movements, he pauses and reads it once, and a noticeable, warm smile spreads across his face. He taps send with his right thumb in one clear motion, exhales, and leans back into the chair, his eyes lifting briefly from the phone toward the lamp-lit room and back to the screen. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical; he never looks into the lens. The camera holds a static shot. His lips stay closed; he does not speak. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet domestic room tone, soft tapping on the phone screen, a single short send sound, and the creak of the desk chair as he leans back.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
